prompt.zh-TW: 綠丘單車行的存貨週轉率從去年的 {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} 降到今年的 {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}}，兩年的營業成本差不多。最可能發生了什麼事？
prompt.en: Green Hill Cycles’ inventory turnover fell from {{number:vars.last|digits=2,unit=times}} last year to {{number:vars.now|digits=2,unit=times}} this year, with cost of sales about the same. What most likely happened?

text.zh-TW: 年底囤了比較多賣不掉的車款，存貨餘額變大
text.en: More unsold models were sitting in stock at year end, so the inventory balance grew

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。成本差不多、週轉率變低，就是分母的存貨變大了；該去看是哪些車款賣不動。
feedback.en: That’s right. With cost about the same, lower turnover means the inventory in the denominator grew; the next step is to see which models are not selling.

text.zh-TW: 進貨價格變便宜，所以營業成本下降
text.en: Purchase prices fell, so cost of sales dropped

feedback.zh-TW: 你從分子想起，方向可以理解。不過題目說營業成本差不多，分子沒有明顯變化；週轉率變低主要來自分母的存貨變大。
feedback.en: Starting from the numerator is understandable. But cost of sales is about the same, so the numerator did not change much; the lower turnover comes mainly from a bigger inventory in the denominator.

feedback.zh-TW: 賒帳影響的是應收帳款與應收款項週轉率，不會改變存貨週轉率。
feedback.en: Credit sales affect receivables and receivables turnover; they do not change inventory turnover.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}}＝營業成本 ÷ 存貨。分子不變、比率下降，只能是分母變大，也就是{{option:o_25y3}}。{{option:o_xwbw}}與題目的前提不符，{{option:o_z4fc}}影響的是另一個指標。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}} = cost of sales ÷ inventory. With the numerator unchanged, a lower ratio can only mean a bigger denominator, which is {{option:o_25y3}}. {{option:o_xwbw}} contradicts the premise, and {{option:o_z4fc}} affects a different ratio.
